ABOUT US

About Us

At Larson Plumbing, we offer top quality residential and commercial plumbing repairs and plumbing installation. Larson's team of licensed and professional plumbers strive day after day to build an honest and courteous relationship with our clients in the Tampa Bay Area. We have been family owned and operated for over 28 years, and we work to provide the best service to our clients 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Our Team

As a family owned and operated company, customer service is our top priority and that begins the moment we pick up the phone. We've put together a team of plumbers and support staff that are as committed to service as we are.

Meet Owners & Operators

Chris Larson - Founder, Owner & Operator

Chris comes from a family of plumbers and worked in the trade for many years before deciding to open Larson Plumbing. In 1991, Chris started Larson Plumbing by himself with one van and has been blessed to grow the company into a trusted, respected and successful plumbing company.


Chris is a past member of Plumbing Heating Cooling (PHCC Tampa), The Rotary Club of Brandon and ABC Apprenticeship School for Plumbing. When Chris is not working or sharing his time with the community as a volunteer, he enjoys boating, fishing, restoring Fords and spending time with his family.

Vonda Larson - Founder, Owner & Operator

Vonda is a Florida girl, born in Tampa, and has lived in the Riverview area her entire life. Vonda has been a key to the success of Larson Plumbing. In the beginning, she was in the background offering moral support and helping part-time as needed while she and Chris started their family.

﻿

Vonda and Chris were blessed twice with two children. Chris and Vonda decided it was important for her to be a full time mother and work in the home when they started the business. Now that the children are adults, Vonda works as an Administrative Assistant and Sales Representative.

Contact Larson Plumbing, the experienced, meticulous, honest plumber for any plumbing related issues.
